allow: PowerShell(foreach \($c in @\('python','py','docker','git','make','node'\)\) { $g = Get-Command $c -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($g\) { "$c => $\($g.Source\)" } else { "$c => MISSING" } }; "---"; try { python --version } catch { "no python" }; try { py -3 --version } catch {}; try { docker --version } catch {}; try { git --version } catch {})

PowerShell(docker info --format '{{.ServerVersion}} {{.OSType}}'; "---compose---"; docker compose version; "---ports---"; foreach \($p in @\(5432,6379,8000\)\) { $r = Test-NetConnection -ComputerName localhost -Port $p -InformationLevel Quiet -WarningAction SilentlyContinue; "$p in-use=$r" })

PowerShell(py -3.12 -m pip --version; "---net---"; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri https://pypi.org/simple/fastapi/ -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 15; "pypi reachable: $\($r.StatusCode\)" } catch { "pypi UNREACHABLE: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })

PowerShell(foreach \($c in @\('uv','poetry','pipx','ruff','mypy'\)\) { $g = Get-Command $c -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($g\) { "$c => $\($g.Source\)" } else { "$c => MISSING" } }; "---docker desktop---"; if \(Test-Path 'C:\\Program Files\\Docker\\Docker\\Docker Desktop.exe'\) { 'Docker Desktop.exe present' } else { 'Docker Desktop.exe NOT found' }; \(Get-Process 'Docker Desktop' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object\).Count)
